messages.author: 1d7fa0b0c073a2ce
messages.subject: *** caught segfault ***
parts:
Hi,

I've created a data frame with the same structure that is created with
melt() (dependent variable, independent variable, grouping). I am
attempting to use facets to plot using the t1 variable as a grouping.
The ggplot command works well with other data created using melt.

When attempting to plot the data using ggplot I get the following
error:
*** caught segfault ***
address 0x1, cause 'memory not mapped'

the data is here http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/web/p.RData

the following is the ggplot command:

m2 <- p[order(p$price), ]
theme_set(theme_bw())
#pdf(file="feed_cons.pdf", dpi=600)
l <- ggplot(p, aes(x=price, y=sum, group=t1))
l <- l + geom_line() + labs(x="biofuel marginal price ($/gge)",
y="bioenergy produced (MGY or MWe)")+ facet_grid(t1 ~ .,
scales="free_y", )
l
ggsave(file="base_prod.pdf", dpi=600)
ggsave(file="base_prod.eps", dpi=600)
dev.off()

system:
Ubuntu 9.1
platform i486-pc-linux-gnu arch
i486 os linux-gnu
system i486, linux-gnu
status major
2 minor 9.2
year 2009 month
08 day 24
svn rev 49384 language
R version.string R version 2.9.2 (2009-08-24)

Thanks very much!

PT

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: *** caught segfault ***
parts:
Hi PT,

This is unlikely to be a ggplot2 bug and is probably caused by the EPS
driver, so unfortunately there's not much I can do, except recommend
that you try a newer version of R.

Hadley
